info.title: dotnet-keel
info.description: dotnet keel diff: compares the api.manifest.json of two git refs or two files and lists breaking, security and compatible changes, as text, Markdown (for pull request comments and release notes) or JSON. Exits non-zero on breaking changes when asked to.

options.name: --manifest
options.description: A manifest to compare (repeatable). Default: every *api.manifest.json in the repository.

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the report to a file instead of the console.

options.name: --fail-on
options.description: Exit with code 1 on: breaking, security (breaking or security), any, or none (default).
